title: Require Artifact Directory Aggregate Shape
forbids: semantic-module artifact collections outside the positive index plus artifact-module topology
why: Every artifact-producing semantic module owns one index and immutable data-product modules. Closing that positive physical directory shape makes direct membership auditable while the typed defineArtifactCatalog API owns registered module compatibility without a second source parser.
remediate: Keep only index.ts and *.artifact.ts modules in each semantic-module artifact collection. Inline artifact-private schemas and move genuinely shared primitives to the nearest atoms owner.
message: Semantic-module artifact directories must match the positive artifact blueprint source topology.
